scope: Coefficient-independent rejection sieve for future declared-nonzero supports of the K77 degree-changing blocks.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: support graphs for D2:C2_to_C1 and D1:C1_to_C0
gu_typed_objects.action_owner: absent until an owner-authenticated coefficient packet is supplied
gu_typed_objects.target: necessary support compatibility with D1 D2=0

theorem.obstruction: A target-source entry with exactly one declared-nonzero two-step path contains one nonzero product and cannot vanish.
theorem.necessary_rule: Every connected target-source pair needs zero or at least two support paths before nilpotence is possible.
theorem.ceiling: Zero or multiple paths do not prove coefficient-level nilpotence.

claim_ceiling: Exact necessary support rejection only. Passing the sieve does not prove nilpotence, actual rank, domain preservation, action ownership, properness or physical cohomology.
